hook.name: Luck
hook.description: A combined ERC20 token and Uniswap v4 hook that charges a tiered ETH tax on buys and sells. Tax starts at 20% for the first 10 minutes post-launch, drops to 10% for the next 10 minutes, then settles at 3%. Collected ETH is forwarded to a hardcoded treasury address. A separate admin can adjust the rate downward within the scheduled tier cap.
